variants.headline: Ordered goods reach the dock
variants.body: The company {company} has received its imported order of {good} at the port. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: An order completes its long journey
variants.body: Imported {good} ordered by {company} has landed at the colony's port. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Imports landed and paid for
variants.body: The company {company} has taken delivery of its home-world order of {good}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
